reuse.why: It calls the shared assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but the provider-specific parts are produced by copying linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions rather than extracting a shared link/download routine.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount (~75 lines) and downloadFintegraTransactions a copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (~35 lines), differing only in the provider name and server URL.

placement.why: Handler, registration, download function, server URL, provider list and account type each sit exactly where the tree keeps the other providers' equivalents.

scope.why: Only the server-side pieces the request lists, plus a release note.

maintainability.why: A sixth copy of the link flow and another copy of the download flow means any future change to linking or downloading must be made in yet one more place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared link-account or download abstraction exists in the tree to go around; the shared guard and sync helpers are called.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions are verbatim apart from names, not disguised.
